candidateCounts.scope: Measured segment counts, not built states. Road interval excludes all restriction member ways at lower end and none at upper end. History ceiling sums all candidate proper prefixes; mode/relevance/failed candidates may overcount. Node barriers affect transitions, not road records.

capacity.scope: Input/state-ratio worker heuristic, not a bound. Prior complete-container export peak was near cap; measured preparation and worker estimates alone do not admit a full build.

sampling.scope: Periodic samples can miss brief composition peaks. Field maxima are not simultaneous and must not be summed. memory.peak is a separate cumulative kernel counter; host/VM paging is unmeasured.
